issues.description: play.ts ships as a debugging scratchpad with local source imports and console.log residue
issues.detail: play.ts was repointed from the canonical zod/v4 import to a deep relative path into packages/zod/src and filled with console.log debug cases. This is the author's local scribble, not a shippable change. Drop it from the PR before merge.

issues.description: JSON.stringify used as structural equality in two hot dedup loops is wrong and slow
issues.detail: finalize() compares JSON Schema values via JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b) in two near-identical loops. This is key-order sensitive, undefined-dropping, lossy on NaN/Infinity, and O(n*size) per node. Extract a named structural-equality helper over JSON Schema fragments with a stated contract, or dedupe by identity where possible.

issues.description: Override callback semantics silently changed; overrideCount doubled 6 to 12 without justification
issues.detail: The previous `if (!seen.isParent) ctx.override(...)` guard was removed, so override now fires for every seen entry including parents. The test literally named "do not run on references" was updated from 6 to 12 calls to make it pass. Either restore the guard or document the new contract explicitly in changelog and code.

issues.description: flattenRef recursion on seen.parent has no termination guard analogous to seen.ref=null
issues.detail: The ref branch uses `seen.ref = null` as its recursion guard, but the new recursive call on `seen.parent` has no equivalent sentinel. Termination depends on call ordering and an unstated assumption that parent chains are acyclic. Add an explicit visited set or state and enforce the well-founded order.

issues.description: Seen.ref and Seen.parent complect inheritance source, clone lineage, and visited flag with no written contract
issues.detail: Two fields now carry overlapping meaning, and `ref` is overloaded with three states (undefined, $ZodType, null) where null doubles as a recursion guard. The invariants are nowhere stated on the Seen interface. Separate the visited flag from the inheritance edge, and write the contract on the type so future maintainers cannot re-confuse them.

issues.description: Patch bundles three independent changes that should land as separate commits
issues.detail: The diff combines (a) the parent/ref tracking rework in to-json-schema, (b) the fileProcessor anyOf hoisting which is a user-visible JSON Schema shape change, and (c) flipping ZodMiniType to pass `{parent: true}`. Each is independently reviewable and revertable. Split into separate patches.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this PR is NEEDS-WORK. The core insight — separating processor-set `ref` from clone-chain `parent` — is correct and fixes a real bug for wrapper schemas with ids, but the implementation ships four blocking problems: a debugging scratchpad in play.ts, JSON.stringify-as-equality in two hot dedup loops, silent doubling of override callback invocations against a test named "do not run on references," and a recursive flattenRef whose termination on the parent branch is unproved. The Seen record complects inheritance, lineage, and visited state without a written contract. Tighten the data model, replace stringify-equality with a named structural helper, justify or revert the override change, and split the patch before landing.
